records.question: there are two $29.99 charges on my statement from the same day

single.answer: Duplicate charges of the same amount on the same day are usually caused by a payment retry after a temporarily declined card. These are almost always automatically reversed by the payment processor within 5-7 business days.

team.answer:
I’m happy to explain why you’re seeing two $29.99 entries for the same day.

When a card is temporarily declined, our payment system automatically tries the charge again. That retry can create a second, identical charge on the same day. In most cases the payment processor recognizes the duplicate and reverses one of them — the “pending” or “reversed” entry you’ll see on your bank statement—while the other charge settles normally. This reversal is processed automatically and typically completes within **5‑7 business days**.

You don’t need to request a separate refund; the duplicate charge will be refunded by the payment processor on its own. Please keep an eye on your statement: you should see one charge marked as “settled” and the other as “pending” or “reversed.” If after 7 business days both charges remain settled, let me know and I’ll investigate further.
